template.title: Route new leads to the right salesperson
template.author: claude-opus-5-5 (frontier author; hand-written 2026-10-21 for research/surface-20261021 BUILDER-1)
template.whenToUse: Someone wants each new lead (from a web form or leads sheet) sent to the right person on their team by simple rules (region, country, source, company size, budget), with a log of who got what.
template.notFor: Replying to the leads themselves, scoring leads with AI, adding leads to a CRM, cold outreach or newsletters.
sources: experiments/library/cards/catalog.json P02 fetch -> transform -> write, P04 draft -> check -> deliver

slots.name: rules
slots.question: Who should get which leads? I need an e-mail address for each person.
slots.askWhy: Leads contain people's contact details; I will not guess where they go.
slots.description: Routing rules, checked in order; the first that matches decides who gets the lead. Empty when everything goes to one person.

fields.name: field
fields.description: Lead column the rule looks at.

fields.name: op
fields.description: is: the column equals the value (text, ignoring case); atLeast: the column is a number at least the value.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The value to compare with, e.g. EMEA, Germany, referral, 200.

fields.name: assignTo
fields.description: E-mail address of the person who gets these leads.

slots.name: defaultAssignee
slots.question: Who should get leads that no rule covers? (one e-mail address)
slots.askWhy: Every lead has to go to someone; I will not guess who.
slots.description: E-mail address of the person who gets every lead no rule matches (or every lead, when there are no rules).

data.leads: one row per lead: name, email, company, region, country, source, companySize (number of employees), budget (number), message, status (new | contacted | spam)
data.lead-log: the flow appends one row per routed lead: name, email, company, assignTo, assignedAt

willDo: Read the leads sheet and take the leads marked new
Send each one to the first matching person ([[rulesText]]); everything else to [[defaultAssignee]]
E-mail that person the lead's details, one e-mail per lead, after you approve each send
Log who got which lead in the lead-log sheet
Check, by re-reading the outbox and the log, that every lead went to exactly one person
willNotDo: Change the leads sheet or mark leads as contacted
Touch leads marked spam or already contacted
Run by itself: you (or your coding agent) start each run

workflow.title: New lead routing
workflow.goal: Each run, send every new lead to the first matching person ([[rulesText]]; otherwise [[defaultAssignee]]), one e-mail per lead after a person approves it, and log the assignment.

assumptions: The leads sheet holds one row per lead with name, email, company, region, country, source, companySize, budget, message and status
Delivery is a local outbox file standing in for e-mail; nothing leaves this machine
risks: A lead sent to the wrong person or to no one
A lead's details sent outside the team
successCriteria: Every new lead was sent to exactly one person
Every assignment is in the lead log
This run delivered exactly the planned e-mails, each intact (checked by re-reading the outbox)
unsupported: Running on a schedule by itself

nodes.description: Keep the new leads that have an e-mail address
Pick the person for each lead
E-mail each lead to its person
E-mail the lead to its person (asks you first)
Log who got which lead in the lead-log sheet
Who should have received a lead e-mail
Re-read the outbox: one e-mail per lead to its person, each intact
Re-read the lead log: one row per routed lead
